title: Bedrock Anthropic passthrough must build a new body, not mutate the caller's payload
answers: gateway fallback to Bedrock sends wrong body after first provider fails
Bedrock passthrough removes model field and breaks the fallback provider
why does AmazonBedrockProvider copy the payload before passthrough
anthropic messages fallback endpoint returns error on second leg
body:
Symptom: when an endpoint with a Bedrock fallback leg fails over, the next provider receives a body missing fields or with a stray `anthropic_version`, or returns an error on the route.
Root cause: `mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py:AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough` takes the same `payload` that `FallbackProvider` later hands to the next provider.
Fix pattern: never pop or edit `payload`; build `body = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k not in ("model", "stream")}` and add `anthropic_version` to that copy.
Constraints: applies to any provider whose passthrough rewrites the body for its own URL or schema. Bedrock takes the model and streaming mode from the URL, so `model` and `stream` must stay out of the JSON body while remaining in the caller's payload.
applies: Changes to AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough or to passthrough body rewriting in any provider used as a FallbackProvider leg.
says: Gateway route fallback fails on the second model provider after Bedrock fails.
Failover endpoints return bad request errors because the model parameter is missing.
Requests should seamlessly route to the backup provider when the primary endpoint fails.
Subsequent providers in a gateway failover chain receive corrupted request payloads.
Keep original request options intact when switching between providers in routing rules.
search: In the MLflow AI Gateway, Bedrock Anthropic passthrough must construct a new request body rather than mutating the caller payload in place. In mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py:AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough, mutating payload corrupts the dictionary shared with subsequent legs in FallbackProvider. The copied body must omit model and stream—which Bedrock supplies via URL parameters—and add anthropic_version without modifying the original caller dictionary.
